integrity: Exact algebra and independent symbolic checker supplement a self-contained proof; no human validation or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Sharp classification proved for the pure power radial weight on the punctured unit disk; no analogous classification asserted for nonzero outer boundary weight or for arbitrary domains. Historical priority is provisional; earlier work contains the kernel and metric definition.
title: Sharp curvature-sign transition and cubic-root bubbles in meromorphic Bergman metrics
